duas.text_arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
duas.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah
duas.translation_en: We have reached the morning, and the whole kingdom belongs to Allah. Praise be to Allah. There is no god but Allah alone with no partners.

duas.text_arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
duas.transliteration: Amsayna wa amsal mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah
duas.translation_en: We have reached the evening, and the whole kingdom belongs to Allah. Praise be to Allah. There is no god but Allah alone with no partners.
In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal birra wat-taqwa, wa minal amali ma tarda
duas.translation_en: O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for such deeds that are pleasing to You.
